description: The mandate layer between an agent and a moving machine. Physical task authority is exercised only inside a Herald-signed mandate pinning agent x robot serials x human-authored task-template hashes x workspace envelope x speed/force ceilings x occupancy class x time window, enforced at a site bridge that is the only routed path to the robot; every session — including refusals, gaps, envelope exits, and human overrides — is sealed into a Blackbox-form evidence pack verifiable offline (Tether Proof), with a static conformance checker (Tether Gauge) for mandates and templates before any robot moves. No T2 direct-motion surface exists in v0/v1. Spot position: governance + evidence for SDK-direct and multi-vendor sites, NOT Orbit dispatch. Tesla Optimus: published wait position (closed platform), never a logo wall. A mandate never substitutes for a site risk assessment; ceilings are outputs of a human risk assessment. P0 is simulator only (ROS 2 + Gazebo + UR-class arm sim); liability counsel gates P1 real motion only.
